Rohit (People Ops): quick thread: question from a new parent about the dependent-care stipend while they're on unpaid parental leave. are they still eligible for the monthly childcare/top-up during the leave period?
Lena M: good one. i assumed stipends pause on unpaid leave but not 100% sure.
Rohit (People Ops): short answer: it depends on whether benefits deductions continue. policy: stipend-eligible employees who maintain active payroll enrollment and benefits deductions continue to receive the monthly dependent-care stipend. if payroll enrollment stops (unpaid leave without deductions) stipend is paused.
Carlos: how does that work for short unpaid gaps like intermittent leave?
Rohit (People Ops): for intermittent/unpaid gaps under 30 days we can make an exception and pro-rate the stipend for that month if People Ops + Payroll approve. submit a request via the stipend exception form.
Mia (Manager): any retroactive fixes if someone forgot to file and stipend stopped? we had a case last year.
Payroll Bot: Retroactive adjustments possible within 90 days of the stipend stop date. Provide payroll case ID, signed manager approval, and dates. Use https://intranet.redwood/payroll/retro-ops to start.
Rohit (People Ops): required fields for the request: employee name, employee ID, leave start/end, whether deductions continued, manager approval (name + timestamp), and desired remedy (reactivate or retro-pay).
Lena M: do international employees follow same rules (EMEA/APAC)?
Rohit (People Ops): local regulations can affect stipend handling. For EMEA/APAC please include the local HR rep in the request and allow an extra payroll cycle. we'll route to People Ops EMEA for approval.
Carlos: what's the communication we should give to employees so they can plan?
Rohit (People Ops): i recommend a short blurb in the leave packet: "Dependent-care stipend continues only if you remain on active payroll with benefit deductions. If you will be unpaid, submit a stipend exception request before your leave starts to discuss pro-rating or temporary pause." i'll update the leave checklist today.
Mia (Manager): noted 12 i'll tell my report to file the form before they go out. thanks.
Rohit (People Ops): thanks all. filing note: People Ops will pre-clear common cases if managers cc us on the leave approval email.
